source.title: TSM Bio Energy Wastewater Management and Methane Capturing for Electricity
source.methodology: ACM0014 version 3.1 stated in the PDD; UNFCCC listing labels ACM0014 ver. 3
source.project_location: Kaeng Sian, Mueang Kanchanaburi, Kanchanaburi, Thailand
source.project_linkage: The PDD states that TSM Bio Energy was contracted by Thai Sugar Ethanol Co. Ltd. to manage wastewater from its ethanol facility.
source.public_access_note: The UNFCCC listing says the project participant chose to make the PDD publicly available directly on the UNFCCC website.

monitoring_design.biogas_flow: Continuous at main gas outlet using a pre-calibrated flow meter; annual aggregation in calculations.
monitoring_design.methane_concentration: Quarterly sampling with a calibrated portable gas meter and stated 95% confidence level.
monitoring_design.leakage: PDD describes a 5% default for months when leakage is detected; it also uses 5% in an ex-ante calculation while separately saying leakage is not expected.
other_relevant_parameters: COD at digester and downstream lagoon

source_reported_ex_ante_model_values.locator: PDF printed pages 39-44 and 49-50; extracted pages 38-43 and 48-49
source_reported_ex_ante_model_values.use_limit: Keep as a historical project-method example. Do not use as current TSM inventory, per-litre product result, or independent verification.

internal_consistency_review.issue: Annual biogas volume conflicts with declared operating days
internal_consistency_review.assessment: The PDD's annual values do not reconcile to its stated 300 operating days; 22.63 million biogas and 219,000 m3 wastewater correspond to 365 days, while 22.81 million corresponds to neither stated basis.

internal_consistency_review.issue: Methane content and methane mass concentration have an unresolved basis
source_values: 0.0067 kg CH4/m3 used in the leakage calculation
internal_consistency_review.assessment: The document does not provide a gas reference condition or a clear fraction basis that reconciles the reported 55% content with the mass concentration used in the calculation. Do not convert one to the other or recompute leakage from these inputs.

internal_consistency_review.issue: Displayed leakage calculation does not reproduce the printed result if displayed parameters and units are applied literally
internal_consistency_review.assessment: The displayed output does not match the literal equation inputs. The separately printed 55% methane value and ambiguous mass-concentration basis may indicate a transcription/unit issue, but the source does not resolve it.
Different PDD sections use these values for design or baseline calculations without a clear reconciliation in the reviewed locators.

internal_consistency_review.issue: Leakage-factor semantics differ between parameter description and ex-ante calculation
source_values: 5% default applied in months when leakage is detected
5% used in annual ex-ante leakage equation
internal_consistency_review.assessment: The period/trigger for applying the default is not resolved in the document sections reviewed.

not_usable_as: evidence the proposed project operated as designed

review.review_scope: Official UNFCCC listing and linked 73-page PDD inspected through web text extraction; selected page locators checked; no local download/hash or page-image rendering performed.

bounded_follow_up_search.scope: Two targeted UNFCCC-domain searches for a separate TSM monitoring report or monitoring-report file storage record
bounded_follow_up_search.result: No separate monitoring report surfaced; search result returned the validation listing and PDD only. This is not proof that no report exists elsewhere or is available on request.
